nodes.label: SUCKIN classification gap causes obstacle_persist:wall_dist FAULT
nodes.norm_label: suckin classification gap causes obstacle_persist:wall_dist fault
nodes.rationale: Bump-outs with depth <= 0.60m (SUCKIN_CUTOFF in maneuver_planner.py) are classified by the detector as SUCKIN once past the bump face; env_monitoring_v2 has no handler for SUCKIN (execution disabled this build), so nothing latches, robot never returns to the wall line, wall distance grows past tolerance, and after 15s the safety monitor faults. Fix options: downgrade SUCKIN to its EXTERNAL part (smallest change), or implement a real SUCKIN recipe from suckin_radii (needs sim sweep).

nodes.label: bump_defer_internal_m 1.5 + internal_max_backup 0.60
nodes.rationale: A bump's inner wall looked like an INTERNAL corner and triggered a bogus latch; deferring the INTERNAL latch after a bump sighting fixed it.

nodes.label: bumpout_max_depth raised to 1.20 m
nodes.rationale: Earlier lower cap rejected deep bump-outs as not executing as a compound bump; raised and verified in sim on a 1.2m box.

nodes.label: Internal-corner over-turn fix: absolute heading segments (_do_internal_corner)
nodes.norm_label: internal-corner over-turn fix: absolute heading segments (_do_internal_corner)
nodes.rationale: Base kept rotating on motor ramp-down while the gantry stroked (yaw drifted -143 to -124.7deg); each 45deg segment was relative so drift compounded, overturning to ~110deg. Fixed by targeting absolute heading origin+idx*seg_angle per segment; compile-checked only, not yet run in sim or on robot.

nodes.label: max_approach_angle_deg 10 cap on psi_cmd
nodes.rationale: STRONG kd gave atan(1.8x0.175)=17deg approach into the wall, lidar lost it (No valid wall pose) and robot stopped; capping at 10deg closes 0.17m error in ~4-5 strips without affecting small 0.05m error cases.

nodes.norm_label: caveat: gantry not homed/attached in sim, strokes completion faked
nodes.rationale: Every stroke logs Z not homed - cannot start stroke and completion is faked after ~2s, so reported areas are commanded paint, not measured paint; real gantry stroke time will differ.

nodes.label: Spray geometry assumption: 1.0 m reach
nodes.rationale: Head 0.312m right of turn axis, spraying along robot's right side; 1.0m reach is an assumption that decides the on-wall/off-wall split of strokes (38 strokes found with no wall within 1.0m).

nodes.label: Internal-corner reverse crawl fix (WALL_DIST fault)
nodes.rationale: After external turn at pillar's end, crawl_total went negative/clamped to 0, pivot left robot too close to wall, tripping WALL_DIST->HOLD->FAULT. Fixed by reversing straight until crawl_backup <= 0.012m before the normal crawl.

nodes.label: killall.sh (stack kill script)
nodes.rationale: pkill -f with a pattern matching the shell's own command line kills the shell (exit 144); use a PID-filtering script instead.

nodes.label: Mid-recipe WALL_DIST skip (corner_align+paint)
nodes.rationale: WALL_ALIGN right after external turn can see a ~0.1m lane error that the following internal approach+turn fixes anyway, so the check is skipped for corner_align+paint when an INTERNAL corner is already latched.

nodes.label: Redundant-stroke gate (section 6)
nodes.rationale: User requirement: no stroke when the robot hasn't moved (translation or rotation) since the previous stroke. Uses raw wheel odom (not EKF-filtered, which lags at turn ends and gave 0.16m phantom movement) plus a fixed gantry offset to compute spray-head position; gates WALL_ALIGN-caller strokes only, never corner-segment strokes (would break segmented-turn resume logic).
